title: PromptingRuleActionAdd
description: The schema the API uses for the 'add' action of /v2/interfaces/rules.

action.description: The action to perform on the rules endpoint.

snap.description: The snap for which to add the rule.

interface.description: The interface for which to add the rule.

PromptingConstraintsCamera.description: Details about the applicability of the new rule to requests.

permissions.description: A map from permission name to the information about that permission.

PromptingConstraintsHome.description: Details about the applicability of the new rule to requests.

path-pattern.description: Path glob matching filepaths for which the rule applies.

permissions.description: A map from permission name to the information about that permission.

lifespan.description:
The lifespan for which the permission applies.

timespan: the permission applies for the given duration specified by the
duration field or until it is deleted

session: the permission applies until the user logs out (specifically,
until the systemd user session ends)

forever: the permission applies until it is deleted

duration.description:
The duration for which the permission is valid. Required if lifespan is
timespan, otherwise must be omitted.
